answer: The most convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions, with the penalty set safely above any single epoch reward. Each agent must post a bonded stake, like a harbor requiring ships to anchor before docking: identity is not a name but capital at risk. Verification work happens at dawn each epoch, when countersigned blocks are re-checked; any verifier caught approving an invalid transaction forfeits its copper
